notes.title: PSYCHOFINGER will participate in Indie FPS Summer Shocase
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're proud to announce that PSYCHOFINGER is part of the Indie FPS Summer Showcase, organized and hosted by the one and only [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/Zlimbratski]ZlimBratSki[/url]!

[previewyoutube=TQoPOV7SXRs;full][/previewyoutube]

Right now, you can check out the Steam event for some FPS games on sale, Demos and upcoming games here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/40645616/sale/IndieFPSSummerShowcase


And later this week, a live showcase will take place! Alongside many amazing indie FPS games, a new trailer for PSYCHOFINGER will premiere.

The trailer will focus on gameplay but will also lay out some [b][i]lore[/i][/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711509/4c62dfc72e38307ad8271dbe7736edf36daeaaa5.jpg[/img]

The show will happen on the 8th of June. You can set a notification so you don't miss it here:

[previewyoutube=8tG-jv3BGYA;full][/previewyoutube]

If you like PSYCHOFINGER and FPS games in general, make sure not to miss it!

notes.title: Devlog #1 - New look, Old Fingers
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone! 
In the last post, we promised to update the look of the game, and now it's time to report on it. [/b]

[h1]Level Redesign[/h1]

We finished redesigning the level and are really happy with the results. Everything looks like a hand drawn picture, and the difference between 3D and 2D elements is barely visible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711509/6aef40d8a9834ebaaf1608cc5f3432599030fe58.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711509/0257f1f6d1f20ca838709740cd7bbb7360bc485c.png[/img]

[h1]Hand redesign, new Weapons and animations[/h1]

The hand was also changed, now it has all 5 fingers! It allows us to make each weapon distinct from each other. And with the help of talented animator, we managed to make animations better and much more interesting! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711509/9f7af3aa5f27eed1b3aeca3ba453d2516ac9fee3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711509/997a1f27f35bad05f5e6faa52a33f12b0d530f7d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711509/63a0b850e3406239976b66f4f729b5bde9f5b1bd.gif[/img]
(some work in progress animation for a weapon) 

[h1]New enemies, levels and bosses[/h1]

We started working on a second level for the game: an abandoned circus! It will be bigger to include larger amount of enemies (bigger in sizes too) and allow you to use movement mechanics more freely. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711509/1632b4cec0ae2f48b12dbc1d84e76d9da9d84c16.png[/img]

Right now, we've made walls and small decorations for it, but in the upcoming weeks it will receive a lot of new decorations and enemies. 

[h1]Want to see all the changes in action? Check out our Steam Store page![/h1]
We made a new trailer with a new track, and it includes all the changes + some more stuff:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2617870/PSYCHOFINGER/

Thank you for sticking with us! We'll try to make devlogs a regular thing to keep you posted about the state of the game <3

notes.title: What to expect from PSYCHOFINGER in 2024?
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

We decided to share some of our plans for 2024 to break the silence and set your expectation for this year. 

[h2]Level Redesign[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711509/5cf7002b362025642f6f86f99c7a991b03c346ef.jpg[/img]
Currently, the level is too dark, lacks details and verticality. We plan to add more interior to make it look more interesting and add more context to the game's story. You can even check out the level concept from our artist below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711509/6aef40d8a9834ebaaf1608cc5f3432599030fe58.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Weapons[/h2]

Shooting with fingers is fun, but is this it? Of course not! We've already made prototypes for more weapons to make your runs different... but without visuals yet. It's a bit hard to come up with "Shotgun Finger" for now, but keep an eye on updates on our social media; you'll see a lot of new stuff pretty soon!

[h2]Enemy variety[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711509/31ac01361e17dfbae5f7ca4ff76b50ff8ca637e3.gif[/img]

What you should definitely expect from PSYCHOFINGER is a high enemy variety both artist and me have so many ideas for enemy design and it's the most enjoyable part of the development for us. Flying, explosive, stinky? and other types of enemies will try to get you.

[h2]New UI[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711509/1fc5a11245f1553bc6741f298b0c6c72d990d7ad.gif[/img]

We heard some criticism towards the game's UI, and we agree with it. A new Health Bar, Upgrade shop, and many other changes will be made so that the UI matches the tone of the game. Also, check out how cool the main menu is! We're really proud of it :)

[h2]Demo and Release dates[/h2]

While our team can't name any dates yet, we can confidently say that you should expect the Demo during one of the Steam Next fests this year. Don't want to miss it? Or maybe want an opportunity to test the game before the demo? Join our Discord server to not miss any news about PSYCHOFINGER.

Discord: https://discord.gg/GAXYUQsV

Other Social Media: https://linktr.ee/psychofinger
